scope: Farm-summary PostGIS GeoJSON and Comprehensive Status location hierarchy contract
checks_cover: Farm and plot boundary/center SQL projections use ST_AsGeoJSON cast to JSONB
Report serializer preserves synthetic GeoJSON objects and null geometry values
Gateway accepts strict Polygon and Point values, including null and empty geometry
Polygon rings require at least four closed positions with consistent 2D or 3D coordinates
Point coordinates require zero, two, or three finite numeric ordinates
Farm-summary embedded location, farm rows, plots, and crop cycles bind to the authorized location and parent IDs
Malformed geometry, extra properties, and mismatched location hierarchy fail closed with no-store errors
rollback: Revert the explicit PostGIS GeoJSON projections, GeoJSON response models and hierarchy validators, focused tests, and evidence; no database rollback is required.
